title: Remove Settings support flat exports
summary: Removed three unused Settings support direct window aliases while preserving namespace access and intentionally consumed globals.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. settingsRawActionPlanSummaryLines, settingsRawActionPlanDetailLines, and renderSettingsMediaPolicyCrossCheck have no direct window.* consumers, while Settings Raw Action Plan rows/status/render, Settings render/getLastSettings, Launch policy-impact helpers, patch-state helpers, writeSettingsPatchJson, and initSettingsViewEvents still have current direct consumers or browser smoke expectations.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed Raw Action Plan summary/detail helpers and the media-policy cross-check render helper both through mediaPipelineSettingsView and direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: Those three helpers remain available through mediaPipelineSettingsView and internal dependency injection, but no longer create direct window.* aliases. Directly consumed Raw Action Plan rows/status/render, Settings render/getLastSettings, Launch policy-impact, patch-state, writeSettingsPatchJson, and initSettingsViewEvents aliases remain unchanged. The global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 391 flat exports.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_settings_support_helpers_are_namespace_only_exports verifies the three removed Settings support helpers remain present in settingsView.js but are no longer direct window.* aliases.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted test failed before the source edit because window.settingsRawActionPlanSummaryLines still existed.
rg "window\.(settingsRawActionPlanSummaryLines|settingsRawActionPlanDetailLines|renderSettingsMediaPolicyCrossCheck)\b" apps\desktop\webview\static tests\webview Docs -n returned no matches.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to restore the three Settings support direct window.* aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline, godfile map, split candidates, global export inventory, summaries, and restore the flat export count from 391 to 394.
notes: Remove three unused Settings support direct window aliases while preserving namespace access and intentionally consumed globals.
